context: A uni student interviews a retired diplomat about meetings abroad
purpose: Teach: メキシコ/ピーター/ジョージ/ジャック/マイケル/トム/チベット/靖国

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 堀江先生、卒論で外交回顧録を扱っていて、メキシコ大使館時代のお話を伺いたいんです。
lines.en: Professor Horie, my thesis covers diplomatic memoirs, so I'd like to hear about your time at the Mexican embassy.
lines.style: Polite university student, slightly nervous but eager interviewer tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ああ、懐かしいねえ。あの頃メキシコには各国の外交官が集まっていて、よくピーターという英国の友人と昼食を取ったよ。
lines.en: Ah, that takes me back. Diplomats from many countries gathered in Mexico, and I often had lunch with a British friend named Peter.
lines.style: Reflective elderly tone, warm and slow with nostalgic pauses.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: へえ、各国の方と交流があったんですね。当時のメキシコは情報のハブだったんでしょうか。
lines.en: Wow, so you interacted with people from many countries. Was Mexico an information hub at that time?
lines.style: Respectful student curiosity, leaning forward with genuine interest.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: そうだね。米国のジョージという書記官や、退役軍人のジャックさんもよく顔を出していてね。
lines.en: That's right. An American secretary called George and a retired military man named Jack often dropped by too.
lines.style: Detailed elder recollection, names emerging gently within the scene.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 議題は何だったんですか?当時はチベットを巡る人権問題が国際的に注目されていましたよね。
lines.en: What were the topics? Back then, human rights issues around Tibet were drawing international attention, weren't they?
lines.style: Probing follow-up question, demonstrating prepared background knowledge.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: うん、チベットの件は皆気にしていたよ。私の通訳を担当してくれたマイケルさんが、よく裏の事情を教えてくれた。
lines.en: Yes, everyone was concerned about the Tibet issue. Michael, who handled my interpretation, often filled me in on what was happening behind the scenes.
lines.style: Lowered, confidential voice sharing sensitive diplomatic details.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そういう非公式な情報って貴重ですよね。靖国参拝への海外の反応についても、何か耳に入りましたか。
lines.en: Such informal information must have been valuable. Did you hear anything about overseas reactions to Yasukuni visits?
lines.style: Cautious, thoughtful student probing into delicate territory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 靖国の話題は本当に難しくてね。一度トムという記者に書斎で詰め寄られた時は、本当に困ったよ。
lines.en: The Yasukuni topic was genuinely difficult. Once when a reporter named Tom cornered me in my study, I really didn't know what to do.
lines.style: Chuckling elder anecdote with a wry, embarrassed smile.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それは大変でしたね。ぜひその場面、回顧録に書いてください。今日は本当にありがとうございました。
lines.en: That must have been tough. Please definitely include that scene in your memoir. Thank you so much for today.
lines.style: Warm student wrap-up, sincere closing gratitude with bright energy.
